top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23, 2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.

top_violation_types.title: Disposing of Gloves after One Use (26 TAC §746.3425(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A caregiver used the same set of gloves to change two children's diapers.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the information gathered during the investigation, it has been determined that a child was left unattended, the caregiver was not at a physical proximity that allowed visual and/or auditory awareness of the child in care.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current health inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child's file was missing a health statement.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The promotion of Physical Activity was not available for review in the Operational Policies.
